text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Friday, October 19, 2018 Posted by admin on October 19th, 2018
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. Dow stock 52 week lows include IBM (IBM).
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +105 points.
Thursday the Dow was down -327.23 (-1.27%) at 25,379.45.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.67%.
There were 6 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Verizon (VZ) +1.28%, Merck (MRK) +0.54% and Exxon Mobil (XOM) +0.43%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by IBM (IBM) -2.61%, Home Depot (HD) -2.55% and Apple (AAPL) +2.34%.
American Express (AXP -1.44%) gained 1% in after-hours trading after it reported Q3 EPS of $1.88, stronger than consensus of $1.77, and then forecast full-year adjusted EPS of $7.30 to $7.40, above consensus of $7.29.
McDonald’s (MCD +0.02%) was rated a new ‘Buy’ at Gordon Haskett with a price target of $185.
Microsoft (MSFT -2.00%) was rated a new ‘Outperform’ at Wedbush with a price target of $140.
Walt Disney (DIS -0.81%) was upgraded to ‘Overweight’ from ‘Equal-Weight’ at Barclays with a price target of $130.
European stocks are mostly lower and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down six-tenths of a cent at $2.866 per gallon.
